title.zh: Pudgy Penguins parent firm shuts down its own blockchain
title.en: Pudgy Penguins parent firm shuts down its own blockchain

current_state.zh: Igloo Inc, parent of Pudgy Penguins, announced it is shutting down its Abstract Chain Ethereum Layer 2 after losing tens of millions of dollars, giving users until December 15 to move funds off while drawing criticism over the short wind-down window and a required class-action waiver.
